introduction: Montana TANF provides temporary financial help for eligible families with dependent children and certain pregnant applicants.
description: Montana TANF provides temporary financial help for eligible families with dependent children and certain pregnant applicants.

sections.who: Financial and household conditions apply. Adults generally have a 60-month lifetime limit and an employability-plan requirement.
sections.get: Cash assistance and TANF Pathways support qualifying families. The agency calculates the household’s benefit.
sections.docs:
• Child or pregnancy information.
  • Income and resource evidence.
  • Requested identity and residency records.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use DPHHS TANF, apply.mt.gov or 888-706-1535.

  2. Provide verification

    Respond to the local Public Assistance office’s requests.

  3. Discuss Pathways

    Ask about the employability plan, child-support cooperation and any relevant exceptions.
sections.after: Keep notices and report changes. Ask the office for current financial standards; the public page contains older tables.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Montana TANF rules and intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
